name: The Old Soldier
summary: An old infantryman by the cab rank: Indian service, a thigh healed short. Holmes saw he was waiting for a grandchild.

name: The Actor
summary: The clergyman outside the chemist's was an actor in costume: greasepaint at the hairline, a script for a book.

name: The Wager Won
summary: Both men read rightly; Holmes will not touch the violin before midnight.

name: The Wager Lost
summary: A black coat, and I stopped looking. The monograph, plates and all.

name: What Asks to Be Seen
summary: We see what asks to be seen. A man who asks nothing of anybody might never once be looked at.
